newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SHO-CRAFT SHARES BOOM AHEAD OF WEEKEND.
newsitem.headline: SHO-CRAFT SHARES BOOM AHEAD OF WEEKEND.

text.p: Shares in development capital firm Sho-Craft Ltd soared for the second day running with investors throwing cash at the stock on Friday following a cautionary issued by the company earlier this week.

The shares, which have been trading in a narrow band of between 60 cents and 110 cents this year, rocketed to close at a record 575 cents on Friday after rising to 280 cents on Thursday. Volumes traded were relatively large.
The company announced on Wednesday that it was in unspecified talks which could impact on its share price. It could not be reached for comment.
Dealers said there was a rumour in the market that a well-known local stockbroker was planning to use it as an investment vehicle.
